'''Columex''', originally known as '''Nardolin''', was a trade [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in relative proximity to the [[Vorzyd Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].

==Description==
Columex was located in the [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC" /> near the [[Vorzyd Cluster]],<ref name="GatORW" /> at the intersection of two major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]: the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a major trade world, dominated by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] known as Columexi. Columex was the capital of the [[Commonality]], a [[confederacy]] of five [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].<ref name="GatORW" />

==History==
Originally known as Nardolin, the world was conquered by [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] as he [[Xim's Expansionist Period|expanded]] his [[Xim's empire|empire]] in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> Remembrance of the Xim era was eventually lost outside of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] due to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[The Devouring|devastation]] of the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Kiirium Reaches]]. Some scholars later incorrectly identified Columex as the ancient [[Wyndigal 2|Huronom]].<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

During the [[Draggulch Period]], Columex was a minor [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] outpost. However, the proximity with the wealthy Vorzyd Cluster attracted [[Commenor/Legends|Commenorian]] investors, including the [[Greyshade family]], five centuries after the discovery of [[Vorzyd]]. They settled Columex and began trading with the Vorzyd Cluster and its confederacy known as the Commonality. Columex joined the confederacy and, in a few generations, Columex became a major trade world. The aggressive Columexi traders allowed Columex to take control of the entire Commonality and expanded it. The Commonality eventually joined the Republic as a group of five sectors.<ref name="GatORW" />

Columex seceded from the Galactic Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> By this time, the Commonality was represented by in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jheramahd Greyshade]]. He was later succeeded in office by his cousin, [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]].<ref name="VSV2">{{SW|url=news/viva-space-vegas-the-history-of-the-marvelous-wheel-part-2|series=Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>

When the Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|fell]], Senator Simon Greyshade declared a state of emergency in the Commonality. Greyshade later agreed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] could seize a part of the Commonality [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] profits in exchange of the control of [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], to a Columexi company controlled by Greyshade. Simon Greyshade remained senator until the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. The Commonality was later ruled by a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]],<ref name="GatORW" /> [[Diedrich Greyshade]]<ref name="VSV2" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Columex was annexed by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Treuten Teradoc]] and became one of the major trade worlds of the [[Greater Maldrood]]. After the fall of the Greater Maldrood, the planet remained under Imperial control until the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TEA" /> Columex and the Commonality later refused to join the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and became independent.<ref name="GatORW" /> Columex briefly returned to being under Imperial rule when the planet surrendered to Imperial forces during [[Operation Shadow Hand]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Attack on the Columex system|Columex was conquered]] and razed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during [[Yuuzhan Vong War|their invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="GatORW" />
